ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows one balloon attached to a basket labeled max 80 kg, and two balloons attached to a basket labeled max 180 kg. Reasoning: Let L be the total lifting capacity of one balloon and B be the basket weight. With one balloon, its lift equals the basket plus 80 kg of extra load, so L = B + 80. With two identical balloons, the lift equals the basket plus 180 kg of extra load, so 2L = B + 180. Substitute L = B + 80 into the second equation: 2(B + 80) = B + 180. Then 2B + 160 = B + 180, so B = 20. Final answer: 20 kg.
